decision: ADR-023 §3 (owner decision 2026-10-10, NX-026 D6; dispatcher confirmation 2026-10-10 that this side table is how an Action definition declares its effect category): a contact restriction stops only effects that reach the customer. Each effect Action declares customer_contact or non_contact_service; a non-contact Action lists the input parameters that carry a customer notification (an intent with any of them non-empty is refused while the customer is restricted: send the notification as a reply bound to an inbound message instead). Applied by trusted configuration only (nexloop_configurator) and frozen by the digest of the tenant's published definition; an Action without a row for its current digest is treated as customer_contact. v2 (0153, dispatcher 2026-10-11): optional external_effect per Action. An external effect (executed by a system outside NexLoop) is dispatched only when the deployment, tenant and Action real dispatch switches are all open; an Action without external_effect, with an invalid value or with a changed definition is external (fail closed). false only for NexLoop's own channels: the native WebChat reply / outbound channel and the loopback incentive ledger. v3 (0178, dispatcher 2026-10-13, NX-037 gap B): nexloop.enterprise.deliver:1, the enterprise delivery executed by the enterprise's own system through its idempotent endpoint, is an external effect and customer_contact: NexLoop cannot verify that the enterprise's execution never reaches the customer, so under ADR-023 §3 (when uncertain, restrict) it is stopped by a contact restriction like a message. A later version may declare it non_contact_service once the enterprise confirms in writing that it never contacts the customer.

actions.purpose: The Agent reply / outbound message channel (NX-047): every request reaches the customer.

AT-043 incentive issue through the loopback ledger (D9: the only provider). Its contact rule is the incentive admission (0145: an attached notification under a contact restriction is refused there); this entry declares only that the loopback ledger is not an external effect. A real incentive channel is a new definition, external until declared otherwise.

NX-037 enterprise delivery: an order executed by the enterprise's own endpoint (POST /v1/effects, Idempotency-Key = intent id; GET to reconcile). Dispatched only when the deployment, tenant and (tenant, Action) real dispatch switches are all open.
